content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: after Hedge Relationship is chosen, a coverage overlay is shown, the hedge relationship screen navigation fires about 10 s later, and the overlay is only removed about 5 s after that navigation, so the screen stays covered for roughly 15 s in all three sessions.", "fix": "Fix: On the Hedge Relationship screen, dismiss the blocking loading overlay as soon as that screen's content has rendered (currently it is removed about 5 s after the navigation event), and start the overlay only when the Hedge Relationship menuitem's async load actually begins rather than before the route change.", "cited_event_ids": ["30:w33", "app:4", "35:x41", "30:w31", "35:x40", "67:w70", "app:6", "72:x76"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The reason the screen takes about 10 s to navigate (backend latency versus frontend work) is not visible in the events.", "The overlay's content and whether it blocks all input are not recorded; only its shown and removed events appear.", "The 18 clicks/keys during the waits are not shown in the windows, so I could not verify which interactions occurred during the overlay period.", "The error and input events after overlay removal (e.g. Trade Date errors) were not analysed as part of this cause."]}
